XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: GEARBOX | P2914 | GROUP | AUTOMATIC | CHANGES | ENGAGES | GOES | N | APPEARS | NEUTRAL | GEAR | ANY |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Applicability: Cars equipped with Dualogic / Selespeed C514-5 automated gearbox

  • System: Gearbox

  • Device: Automated gearbox

  • Fault: The gearbox occasionally shifts into neutral unintentionally. Restarting the vehicle temporarily resolves the issue.

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: P2914 (Current fault in phase U of drive motor E)

  • Cause: Faulty automated transmission

• Action: Check the condition and correct operation of the robotised gearbox assembly and, if necessary, replace it

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The component is located above the gearbox, in the engine compartment on the driver’s side
